explication: adb-mcp lets an MCP-compatible AI client issue commands to Adobe applications. Application-specific Python MCP servers expose the tools and use shared command and socket-client code; a Node proxy bridges them to plugins because UXP plugins connect as socket clients. Plugins route commands into app-specific operations and return results. The README documents the broad bridge and supported applications; sampled source confirms several UXP routing paths, but not every MCP tool-to-command mapping or the CEP internals.
